concrete_findings.issue: A same-owner check alone permits a second private witness ledger and therefore a fresh occurrence allowance.
concrete_findings.initial_reproducer: Real runtime ledger retained 20,000 witnesses; fresh _WitnessLedger(job) retained one more. Same owner identity was true; the two ledgers totaled 20,001 without mutating counters. This was a design-risk probe of the underlying private primitive, not a public-input exploit.
concrete_findings.closure: W04 witness entry verifies both the exact owner and owner._witness_ledger is ledger before reserving. Fresh ledger now raises TypeError with zero retained witnesses; the legitimate full ledger raises WU9-L13 and preserves 20,000.

concrete_findings.issue: Admitted duplicate Evaluation role slots produced duplicate canonical edge keys and made traversal fail its strict key invariant.
concrete_findings.initial_reproducer: Appending a duplicate role binding to an actual admitted pool yielded five eligible edges but four unique keys; _shortest_path raised invalid_private_representation. Ordinary duplicate target_refs were correctly rejected by inherited admission and were not changed.
concrete_findings.closure: Canonical graph links coalesce an identical source/role/target key, while the complete original source entity retains all three supplied role slots. The repaired projection has four unique edges and successful traversal.

concrete_findings.issue: A nested role-support selector containing only the role loses which same-role object binding supplied the support pointer.
concrete_findings.closure: Nested support selectors contain both role and object_ref, using delimiters excluded from admitted identifiers. Two executor objects sharing one EvidenceReference retain distinct canonical links; no input-array index is used.

concrete_findings.issue: A whole-projection candidate aggregate is not the PC04 question about the relations actually relied on by a result; unrelated candidates and PC09 reasons could incorrectly change that aggregate.
concrete_findings.closure: Projection returns pc04=None. _check_edge_eligibility checks an explicit current-projection edge selection. In a paired real-input case an affirmed disputed relation returns PC04 met while preserving premise_disputed; selecting its denial returns unmet, and selecting no edges returns not_applicable. Foreign edge identity/current-job validation remains mandatory.

concrete_findings.issue: A multi-Claim assertion scope does not rebind the actual Claim version of resolved EvidenceItem endpoints.
concrete_findings.initial_reproducer: Root identified an admitted E-to-E relation whose two items bind claim2 while its assertion scope lists claim and claim2; a claim-only query had incorrectly used that relation.
concrete_findings.closure: Shared _edge_scope resolves EvidenceItem endpoint bindings for both projection and selected PC04. Independently rechecked: claim query excludes the edge and returns selected PC04 unmet; claim2 includes it and returns met. Versions are not merged.

concrete_findings.issue: Cycle tuple concatenation and the subsequent _Path constructor perform separate repeated payload passes.
concrete_findings.closure: _canonical_cycle now prospectively charges 6*(prefix node count + prefix edge count)+27 before concatenation and constructor visits, independently of prefix reconstruction work. Frozen-code oracle rechecks cycle behavior.

concrete_findings.issue: Absence-witness starts+frontiers+terminals concatenation repeats the earlier groups and must be prepaid as an actual copy.
concrete_findings.closure: The constructor path prepays 2*starts + 2*frontiers + terminals + 2 before concatenation, then separately charges each lookup. It retains the complete completed search payload and does not substitute an empty positive path.

concrete_findings.issue: An empty explicit relation selection must not silently expand to every predicate in the chosen view.
concrete_findings.closure: Relation candidates require a paid explicit predicate match. A claim-origin query with no selected predicates has no positive relation edges; canonical record links remain governed by their separate view whitelist.

findings_and_repairs: Projection second full round had 16 annotation regressions: explicit predicate selection accidentally removed published_by/same_identity_as metadata. They remain scoped annotations with no traversal edge or identity merge; final 336 passed.

Allowed repeated Evaluation role/object bindings initially produced duplicate canonical edge keys and traversal TypeError. Paid canonical identity dedup retains the complete original record; parallel assertion IDs remain distinct.

PC04 now runs on an explicit relied-on edge set. Projection completion returns no ProviderFact. Negative, time-unknown and empty selections keep their exact state without conflating documentary/conflict/endpoint questions.

An actually admitted multi-Claim assertion exposed wrong-Claim EvidenceItem edge eligibility. Shared endpoint binding checks now apply to projection and PC04; actual paired Claim controls verify the repair.

Role-support selectors now include the actual role and object_ref so distinct bindings sharing a support pointer do not collide. Array positions remain source occurrences, never canonical edge identity.

SCC initial combined run had 1 failure among 34 cases because a 1100-node cycle was required to complete beyond the real per-job budget. The final suite retains that deep graph as an interruption/no-partial control and a separately complete bounded cycle. Quotas and old tests were not changed.

Independent review identified prospective tuple-copy and repeated constructor costs; final code prepays them. Witness factories reject duplicate or foreign ledgers and preserve complete member occurrences.

One exploratory Claim repro initially omitted the existing approved pytest path and failed fixture import. The corrected command reproduced the scope defect; no dependency installation or version change occurred.
